properties.rationale: Deferred on Anthony's word, 2026-07-28. Accepted and not dropped. It is the mechanism req:epochs-can-be-planned already asks for ("an epoch or increment must pin the set of per-repo design versions it means"), so it should be built WITH that requirement's increment rather than ahead of it — building the pin before the temporal axis exists would leave it with nothing to pin to. Both are parked together.
